name: Take ten supported steps
short_description: Take ten supported steps once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can take ten supported steps in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Take ten supported steps means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Take ten supported steps in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Related practice provides transferable context but is not required.
